home.researchTitle: Misinkaca qaafiyat: kusaq nummaak maca iyyam
home.researchText: mesenkaca biyak kalalaanam duuduntaa? Misinkaca digir koo catelee? Soomuuy, maaqooy, xin kee ankacsu wagittam hay? qaduuk, raceenaani gacsitte, sumaq boola edde anuk.
home.appText: currik tan app offline taamitam kee buxah marih fotot doortam duddah, isi aalatal koppi innal daffessa. Inkibisle sabhalal le goolisso: affara kaxxa balaaqitte, wakti lowsiise, ximmo mali.

faq.a: Meqe digir sahlinih, buxah addah kee taqabi sinnim: kaxxa taswiir ittat celta, qaynat, sahlin jigsaw, gaba kalti meqeh tan qangor, qaynat, taswiir bingo kee walal karditte. Tayse doorit num asaaku ruffa edde iyyaama. wakti yayyaaqe maraay, ximmoomaa kee aqayyaare celtah tan faxeemik soolis.
Yeey. Kulli digir kee dahabak yan uddur yatbiqeenim currik tan, akkaawonti sinnim, asta akkek oobisiyya sinnim. Digir elle yakkem qarok-qariita birowseril silkil, tableet akkek kompiiteril.

Dementia kalaloonuh uli digir mayanbullaay, Golden Moments kaadu tu daylisaanam kee kalaloonuh iyyaanam maduudan. Ni digir ruftoo kee wakti sittalih tatrusnaama. Ni mesenkacah qaafiyatih exxa kusaq abam kee yaybulleem baxxaqissa.

faq.q: Tama digir Alzheimer leh yan numuh bictaa?
faq.a: Yeey. Alzheimer biyak kaxxaam mangoh tan dementia biyak kinnim kee tama biyak elle geytimam: kaxxa taswiir elle geytimam, doorit dagoom, kee kassitam kee taqabi lem hinna. ramaddos, uxuxxos kee gaba kalti buxa marih maxcooca qusba barittok muxxi xer waktih ixxigal rakuh tan.

faq.q: inki num sarra caddo le dementiya too abnissoosat yantifiqem duudaa?
faq.a: Mango way, yeey, ken xaqut yan num lih. Qimmis gorris inkibisle namma taswiiril, taswiir nammaytakkoh affara balaaqitte, bisi gali hinnay sabhalal le ufuyrubtih soolo. uxxuk dacris, ken miraaciino katayaay oson duudaanah yanin wak soolis.

fanteena cisab maliiy maysaxxaga mali. nanu googil makeelissot nantifiqem manni galitte guftam cednuh. atu doorteh tan muucitte muucitte nammay takkoh dubuk ku birowseril tanbulleem kee qigdu matakka.
Golden Moments qunxa butta calway, furrayni taswiir taama buxah mara kee dayli marah, web kee free appil abta. Nanu daylaaba hinnino, kee takkel tu matan dayli fayu.

brain-health.title: Misinkaca qaafiyat: Kusaq macaay iyyam
brain-health.seo: Misinkaca qaafiyat kee Dementiyah Qawwalayla: Kusaq macaay iyyam
brain-health.description: mesenkaca biyak kalalaanam duuduntaa? Qadleena, raceenah miracsentitte dementiyah qawwalaylah sababitte, mesenkaca digiritte, soom, maaqo, anfakaakaq, xin, ankacsu.
brain-health.lede: Manni kaxxa kusaaqitte nummaak taybulleem dementiyah qawwalayla salcisaanam, qaduk baxxaqimte, edde anuk sumaq qaku le hinnay gurummaca. Amolladi oyta, qaafiyat fayu hinna.

guide.sourcesNote: nanu massoynaanit nasgoorowem kee kusaaqitte ta gali elle rakittam. Gali yusqussubume wak kulli tii cubbusen.

healthNotice.title: Amolladi oyta, qaafiyat fayu hinna
healthNotice.textHtml: Ta gali buxa marah yewqeh yan kusaq amoomisa. Inki numuh gitat tanim koh warsam maduuda. maaqo, dagar diig, xin, diwaata akkek kibne milaagtaamak naharal daylaabe lih yab. amok radah badit akkek gersi amok radah milaagitte, qaafiyat cato nummaak gey. Ni qaafiyatih oytih maysaxxaga kawisa.

about.title: ittalluk abit abnisso, kassit aqayyaare hinna
about.description: Macaay Golden Moments digir wakti, ximmooma kee streaks, macah taswiir elle tamixxigem, kee nanu dementia wagittaamal maca abnam kee abnam faxximtam.
about.lede: Dahab uddur sabhalal le, furrayni taswiir abnissoosa too dayli kee inki num dementia luk yan num ittat ruffa iyyam duudah.
about.bodyHtml:
Nanu elle naaminem

abnissok ximmo too wakti isih: walal, musuyto, namma taswiir ittat haanam rufto, hinnay sahlinuk xaynal daffeyna. tah num yaqikkiseenim hinna, fooca fan ken gutuqaanam hinnay faxem cedaanam hinna.

mango mesenkaca aydakaakan abnissoosa sissikaaneh dariifal faatacisen, ximmooma, gititte kee caddoodal. Dementia lih yan numuh aqayyaareh innal tatraanam maduudan. Nanu saduh tanim faatacisneeh, nanu ninni too madqooqit nabbixe:

  • Tu raddam matan. Saaqat mali, ximmo, looweyna, mano, gititte, konfetti hinnay loowo, faxe alaalaqal.
  • Kassiisik dagah mamaxxaga. muucitte sugteemih tammulleeh tan. walal arcibisam kee migaaqitte akkek kassit qigdu maqambaalin.
  • Naba, qaduuk kee sabhalal le. kaxxa kutbe kee muucitte, fayyale qeedaalisso, kee kobor too inki aracal yaadiye.
  • Naba marih kunnabna. numma-baadah muucitte kee qaduuk, laqin qangor. kartoonitte, gad-gad faatit akkek emojih kaadooda matan.
  • Sahlin mawqah gita. "Away tekkeh" umman way tanbulle. Gitak garab soolisaanam meqe xalu.
  • sugteemih cankah. Aleey akkaawontitte akkek maysaxxagoogi matan. Atu doorte muucitte ku yahaazal sugta.

Nanu essere waynam

Ni digir ruftoo kee fantaaxaw kinni. Oson dementia kee Alzheimer’s biyak fokkaaqoh, fokkaaqoh, qilsa, dayli, lowsis kee kalalu, kee woo sababah num ken dooraanam mafaxximta. nanu ninni kusaq wagittam naktube wak mesenkaca qaafiyatih galitte, nanu qaduk innam sumaq boolale, kee nanu ninni digirit qigdu nangoorowem madudna.

Nanu miyya kinninom

dahab uddur qunxa currik tan butta. Nanu daylaaba hinnino. Ni miracsentitte, Agat caddol, Agat Caddol, Alzheimer’s Association, deqsitta eglaali elle yeyyeeqen miracsentittek, kulli miracsentitte isi raceenaanih addat tan. Kawis Mannal fiirisnam kee ninni galitte mannal cubbusnam.

maca cattam neh warisey

Nanu maca koh taamittam kee maca taamite waytam, baxsa luk dementia luk yan maraay, buxah marah dayli mara kee taamah taama abeynit lih walalnam fanna. Galelasta {email}.

editorial.title: Nanu ninni galitte mannal naktubeeh, cubbusnaah
editorial.description: Golden Moments mannal kusaaqissaah, kutbe abtaah, raceenaani kee qusba gurral dementia taama kee misinkica qaafiyatih galitte, kee nanu inkih elle yayyaaqen innal.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Ni raceenaani

Nanu ninni miracsentitte elle rakittam ummattah miracsenta massoynaanih axcih Agat inistitute, CDC, Alzheimer's egla, Alzheimer's fawunxeeshin Ameerikak, Buxâ marih hanaawih egla kee NHS, kee butta-fokkaaqoh kusaaqitte axcih Cochrane kusaaqitte kee kaxxa qaafiyat gibbatu. Kulli miracsenta elle rakittam raceenaani roorissa. Nanu umman raceena fakna tet xayyoosak naharal, kee nanu dubuk gabbaaqu abnam is nummaak iyyam.

nanu mannal fiirisnaah

  • Qimmol abinah: asaaku maca abaanam faxxintaah, qado afat.
  • Summaq wagittaamal amaan le: nanu “linked with”, “may” kee “sumaq lih angaaraw le” innam toh numma kinni wak.
  • Massakaxxa le: nanu fiirisenno ummatta wagittam dementia lih furraynu, kee nanu qigdu mantifiqqa esseroora hinnay qaybi af.
  • uli hadliyyi addatino mali: uli bicsen loowo, maxcooca, mihrat leela, kusaaqitte, sekkacsi hinnay sumaq.

Ni galitte kusaaqissam miyyaay

Galitte kutbe kee cubbusso Golden Moments butta, AI kutbeh silaacitteh catotta luk kusaq kee qagunta. Kulli gali butta raceenaanih gabat cubbusan. Ni galitte le hinna kusaaqime daylaabe akkek gersi daylaabe, kee nanu gersinnal yoh taguudeh essero mannu. Oson amo ladi oyta, qaafiyat fayu hinna.

Nanu qigdu atbiqe waynam

  • Digir, maaqo, ossotina, sissikaane akkek maytani kalalu, dayla, salac akkek dayla dementiya.
  • aqayyaare, esseroora hinnay ximmoomay inki num lem, hinnay alle waam, dementia.
  • faxe diwaata qimbisoonuh, soolisoonuh akkek milaagoonuh fayi.
  • Maysaxxaga aw qokleh yan addatino miracsenta innal qellisen.

Asqassaabe kee massos

Kulli gali ellecaboh uddur edde yusqussube ayro yaybulle. atu hoxa geytek hinnay uddur akak tatre raceena, kumagan galelastah rub {email} kee nanu sissikuk gorgorenno.

faq.title: Esseroora kee Gacsitte
faq.seoTitle: Dementiyah digir kee abnissoosa: esseroora kee gacsitte
faq.description: Dementia digir kee taama wagittaamal mango esseroorah gacsa: manni digir gabbattam, magide fanah digirtam, lakal-caddoh mabla, misinkica qaafiyat kee canka.
faq.lede: uxxuk, qado gacsitte esseroorah hanaawise mangom essera.

items.q: Dementiya leh yan numuh tayse digir macaay?
items.a: tayse digir buxa mariino, sahlin kee currik yan gutqo, kee numma tiya faxe num asaaku ruffa edde iyya. Taswiir yanbulle taswiir luk angaaraw, qaynat, sahlin jigsaw, buxah addah qangor gaba kalti, qaynat kee taswiir bingo inkih mango marah meqennal taamita. wakti yayyaaqe maraay, ximmoomaa kee aqayyaare celtah tan faxeemik soolis.
Yeey. Inkih tan digirittee kee matbaqatitte currik tan, akkaawonti sinnim, asta sinnim, oobisiyya akkek maysaxxaga sinnim.

items.q: Xalitteey, caddooda akkek waktitte kah ane waytam macaay?
items.a: Sissikaane kee xalitte rufto le abnisso aqayyaareh korsan, woh wacarriy akkek bakcarra bahtam duuddah. Nanu hangi kah naceem ruftoo kee wakti sittalih, tonnal tu raddam matan kee atu faxe ximmol soolissam duddah.

faxe silki, tableet akkek kompiter uddurtiino le qarok-qariitâ birowseril. tarbeezal solta tableet mango uddur namma num tattab tattab elle digran innah kaxxam bicale gita. TV lih axawah tan laptop buttah meqennal taamita.

items.q: Nanu ninni buxah marih muucittel digirram dudnaa?
items.a: Yeey. muuci nammay takkoh 2 ilaa 6 muuci atu doorte digir fan korissa. muucitte ku birowseril sugtaah, takrimtam akkek daanimtam madudda.

items.q: Inki abnisso magideh uddur sugtam faxxintaah?
items.a: mango uddur 10 ilaa 20 minit mangom, kee inki inki adda 2 minit mayso. ecla akkek bakcarra astooti wagitaay uxih meqem cussutta wak soolis. Massat tan caddo matan.

items.q: oson abnisso abaanam faxe weenik macaay?
items.a: Aleey massakaxxaay, sarra akkek baxsale gital qagitaak gibbat. Ciniyya kak tamaatem eclaay, biyaakaay, asmat sinna akkek uxxuuk fayxi alle waanama. oson bale iyyan wak maca abaanam faxximtam ni miracsenta wagita.

Raat kee qangooruk: kicintoh tan muuziik ankacisaanam, lotion luk gaba massage abaanam, fotot itta luk wagiitaanam, sissik qanxaffe luk gexaanam, irol daffeyna, hinnay kaxxaam sahlin taswiir digir keenik xaqut yan num luk abaanam. nek sarra caddoh miracsenta mango mablooli le.

Yeey. Taswiir bingo matbaqah karditte kee on-screen caller le, kee gaba kalti yab kee walal karditte meqennal taamitta. Ni buxah hanaawih buttah miracsenta buttah mangaay, daffeynaa kee tengeggele dudditte bartaanam duudumtah.

items.q: Digir mesenkaca biyak kalalam akkek salcisam duudaa?
items.a: Wali digir mayanbulla dementia kalaloonuh, kee ni digir tannah yan yoh taguudeh essero maaba. Ayyuntiinô caddol cognitive stimulation lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, baxsa le. Nanu digir xayyosnam ruftoo kee fantaaxaw.

Asmatah hinna. Kusaq 14 Takke Qaafiyat Kee Manô Caagiidal Dementiyah Qawwalayla Lih Angaaraw Lem Qaddoosen, Axcih Maabbiyyi Dacayrih, Fayya Le Qabli Giffa, Dagar Diig Angaaraw Kee Ayyuntiinô Baxsi. Ken aracat haanam inki inki maritteh qawwalayla salcisaanam bictah, takkay immay mango mari kullim meqennal abak uxih dementia biyak le. Qigdu numtin qellat hinna.

items.q: garuq sinni soom mesenkaca qaafiyatah meqee?
items.a: Sahdayti sumaq waado leeh udurruteh, kee mango kusaq saqi addat yan. Soom idoola, baxsa luk sokkar biyak daylitte hinnay qilsa lowsiisoonuh, kee dementia luk yan marah mafaxximta. Atu elle takme gurra milaagtaamak naharal daylaabe lih yab.

Aleey akkaawontitte akkek maysaxxagoogi matan. Nanu Google Analytics wagsiisak gufneh lowsis kee manni galitteh cato abnam kee ku browser kassitam atu lowsis xongoloola lowsissa. atu doorteh tan muucitte nammaytakkoh muucitte qigdu matakka. Addatinoh cankâ maysaxxaga wagita.
bale. dahab uddur wacaysir kee amo ladi xaagi. Qaafiyat esseroorah, daylaabe lih yab, kee sissik catoh 911 hayis.
